name: FerroBRIDGEHl70202ToContactPointUse
title: FerroBRIDGE supplement: HL7 table 0202 to contact-point-use
description: Adds the contact-point-use group of ConceptMap/table-hl70202-to-contact-point-system of hl7.fhir.uv.v2mappings 1.0.0 as a map of its own: CP (Cellular or Mobile Phone) to mobile. The override of datatype-xtn-to-contactpoint writes ContactPoint.use from XTN.3 through it when XTN.2 is not valued. FerroBRIDGE #1762, upstream defect FerroBRIDGE #1764.
